p: holy: That is, void of all pollution, idolatry and superstition both of soul and body.
at your own will: Of your own accord.
deal falsely: In that which is committed to your credit.
go up and down as a: As a slanderer, backbiter, or quarrel picker.
stand against the blood of thy: By consenting to his death, or conspiring with the wicked.
diverse kind: As a horse to leap an ass, or a mule a mare.
shall count the fruit thereof as: It shall be unclean as that thing, which is not circumcised.
observe times: To measure lucky or unlucky days.
round the corners of your heads: As did the Gentiles in sign of mourning.
marks upon you: By whipping your bodies or burning marks in them.
whore: As did the Cyprians, and Locrenses.
rise up before the hoary head: In token of reverence.
meteyard: As in measuring the ground.
ephah: By these two measures he means all other. Of Ephah, read Ex 16:36 and of Hin, Ex 29:40.
